script:
control-agent-server restart
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/git/changes" --query path="$REPO" --expect 200 \
  --raw-out "$F/scoped-changes-restarted.json" --save F15.scoped-restart/changes
cmp "$F/scoped-changes.json" "$F/scoped-changes-restarted.json"
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/git/commits" --query path="$REPO" --expect 200 --check commits.0.sha eq "$C2"
control-agent-server doctor
